page.layout: One page of text; a woodcut ornament above the title; a historiated initial I at the start of paragraph I. No marginal notes. Running head line at top is faint and not legible as a title.

main_text.head: LIBER VII. De Vegetabilibus in communi, ac in fpecie de plantis.
CAPUT I. De vegetabilium in communi effentia, principiis & adjunctis: Vbi de nutritione & augmentatione, atque de generatione.

p.i: Ivum omne vegetabile eft:veruntamen aliud vegetabile tantum, quod planta vocatur: aliud porro fentiens,quod nominatur animal. Nos prius de vegetabili in communi,poft de plantis agemus,& denique de animalibus tractabimus.

main_text.p: §. Poteramus de vegetabili in communi praecedente libro egiffe: verum quoniam fæpe vegetabilis & plantæ nomen confunditur, ideo in hunc librum transtulimus. Perinde vero eft, ubi

page.notes: The initial I is a large woodcut letter, read as "I" with the first word "Ivum". The running head is not legible. Some words in the first paragraph are set in italic and were transcribed as such; "Ivum" may be "Ivum" with the initial letter integrated into the woodcut.
